intended_object: The uniformity condition for a multivariate quotient of polynomial functors, from Avigad–Carneiro–Hudon (named in the docstring and module reference). Whenever abs ⟨a, f⟩ = abs ⟨a', f'⟩, the maps f and f' must have the same range at every index i < n.
explanation: The body says that for any TypeVec α, if two representatives ⟨a, f⟩ and ⟨a', f'⟩ of the polynomial functor have the same image under `abs`, then for every index i, the image of `f i` equals the image of `f' i` (that is, `f i '' univ = f' i '' univ`). This is exactly the paper's uniformity condition, applied index by index in the multivariate setting. It is the direct generalization of the univariate `QPF.IsUniform` in Mathlib/Data/QPF/Univariate/Basic.lean. The definition is stated for an arbitrary MvQPF over TypeVecs of any length n, which is its natural generality. It has no missing hypotheses and no problems in degenerate cases.
